QuestInfo.0: The monsters of the MesoGears have changed. Hunt them to see how much they've changed.

0.0: I was poking around the MesoGears, and I couldn't help but notice that the monsters are different.
0.1: You've fought them before, as I recall. I need you to fight a few and measure the change.

1.0: Hm... So they're weaker now. Good! It'll be easier looking for treasure now!
1.1: Hey, can you come back tomorrow if you have the time? I want to keep tabs on these things, in case they get dangerous again.

mob.0: Battle the monsters of the MesoGears to learn more about them.
